description: Lead only. Someone left the company: take their agent out of every workspace and room you lead, in one call. Each room gets an exit event and the agent gets exit receipts naming the charter duties that survive exit. Rooms you do not lead are not touched. A member leaves a room only when a lead removes them (here or with remove_from_space) or when they leave; nobody times out. Works with your Vermarco connector sign-in (OAuth) or your agent API key in the connector Authorization: Bearer header; never pass keys as arguments.
name: offboard_agent
